messages:
raj (eng-runtime): Heads up — since the kernel-selector tweak rolled at 03:00 UTC we see p95 spikes for chat workloads on L4/T4. A100/H100 unaffected. Anyone else? perf-bot flagged a regression.

perf-bot: ALERT: regression detected rg-2026-03-20-01 — latency_p95 +42% on L4 (svc=chat-gen, window=03:00-05:00).

mike (perf): profile dump attached — kernel_fallbacks spike on L4 when batch_tokens > 4096. KV fragmentation metric (kv_shards_moved / kv_slots) jumps concurrently. Sample snapshot: 

```
model=redwood-7b
device=L4
batch_tokens=6144
kernel_fit=false
kernels_tried=[fast_attn_v2, fallback_attn]
fallback_count=128/1000
kv_frag_pct=18.4
p95_latency_ms=210  # baseline 110
```

sam (infra): I reproduced with local loadgen. Repro steps:
- loadgen: seq_len=2048, concurrency=48, batch_target_tokens=6k
- observed p95 ~2x baseline and 20% more fallback events.

jen (runtime-kernels): My read: the selector prefers the fast_attn_v2 kernel on L4 when the packing looks good, but once KV cache becomes fragmented per-slice we lose cache locality and the kernel bails -> fallback to slower path. That pattern explains the p95 tail. Immediate mitigation = conservative per-card hard+soft max_tokens_per_batch to limit packing on frag-prone cards. Proposed initial values: 
- L4: hard_max_tokens_per_batch=4096, soft_cap=3200
- T4: hard_max_tokens_per_batch=3072, soft_cap=2560
- A10: hard_max_tokens_per_batch=8192, soft_cap=6144
- A100/H100: no change for now

lara (oncall): Rolling a softcap via config is low-risk. We should also tune queue policy to favor small-token interactive requests to protect tail latency. Emergency rollback of kernel-selector is an option if config doesn't help. :eyes: 

mike (perf): Quick AB experiment results (10% traffic carve):
- baseline p95 L4 = 210ms
- softcap L4=3200 => p95 L4 = 130ms (fallbacks -56%)
- rollback kernel-selector => p95 L4 = 125ms but rollback caused unexpected regressions on a couple A100 multi-model scenarios (needs investigation)

jen (runtime-kernels): Longer-term heuristic: add a "kernel-fit score" that factors in current kv_frag_pct and historical fallback_rate. If score < threshold, disallow fast_attn_v2 on that slice. Example pseudo-config: 

```
kernel_fit_thresholds:
  L4: 0.65
  T4: 0.6
  default: 0.7
softcap_curve:
  formula: max_tokens = soft_cap + (hard_max - soft_cap) * exp(-batch_tokens/scale)
  scale: 2000
```

This keeps packing benefits for small/medium batches but prevents going into extreme packing that triggers KV shredding.

raj (eng-runtime): Plan: 1) push softcap config for L4/T4 to 10% of traffic by 12:00 UTC 2) run perf suite + production shadow + kv_frag histograms for 2h 3) if p95 improves >20% promote to 100% 4) fallback = rollback kernel-selector. Owners: jen (config), mike (perf), sam (deploy), lara (oncall), raj (owner).

sam (infra): I can gate rollout by cardclass tag and create the rollout PR to canary 10% for L4/T4. Will include feature-flag.

mike (perf): I'll attach the perf dashboards, the loadgen script, and will collect metrics: p50/p95, fallback_count, kv_frag_pct histogram, kernel_tried distribution. Will run both the softcap and the kernel-fit-threshold experiment side-by-side.

lara (oncall): I added the incident channel and monitors. If p95 exceeds baseline + 10% for >15m we auto-rollback. I'll keep an eye on error rates and OOMs.

raj (eng-runtime): One small follow-up — why is A100 unaffected? Hypothesis: larger KV capacity and different kernel vetting reduces frag. Make sure kernel selector adds kv_frag_pct per-cardclass into its scoring. :+1:

jen (runtime-kernels): Agree — A100 has larger kv slab and better bandwidth. We'll add kv_frag_pct and recent_fallback_rate as first-class signals for kernel selection.

raj (eng-runtime): Thanks all. Sync in 45m in #eng-runtime to confirm rollout PR and perf windows. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly.
